clue.text: Inept cowboy cut end of rope

indicators.note: cut means the word loses its final letter, docked like a tail

parts.note: a gaucho is a South American cowboy

indicators.note: end of picks the closing letter of the word rope

explanation.surface: A clumsy cowhand slices through the end of his lasso.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks the last letter of GAUCHO, leaving GAUCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Gauche describes someone socially awkward or clumsy, a synonym for inept.

clue.text: Notice circuit includes minute light source

parts.note: to notice is to spot

indicators.note: includes signals that the circuit word takes another piece within it

parts.note: a lap is one circuit of a track

explanation.surface: Someone observes that a lap of the track contains a tiny lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotlamp is a lamp throwing a concentrated beam, so a source of light.

clue.text: Ran edition that's turned out unusually large

indicators.note: turned out suggests letters turned over and laid out afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: A newspaper ran an edition that proved surprisingly big.
explanation.definitionFit: Inordinate means excessive, far beyond normal limits in size or amount.

clue.text: Language only army and RAF used?

definitions.text: Language only army and RAF used?

parts.words: Language only army and RAF used?
parts.note: a tongue for a force with soldiers and airmen but no Royal Navy (RN)

explanation.surface: A question about a dialect spoken only by soldiers and airmen.
explanation.walkthrough: With just the army and RAF in action there is no RN, the Royal Navy; run together that names the extinct Norse tongue of Orkney.
explanation.definitionFit: The extinct Scandinavian tongue of Orkney and Shetland, read as a joking military phrase.

clue.text: Was blooming female let down?

parts.note: something let down has been lowered

explanation.surface: A question of whether a woman was disappointed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let down' reads as disappointed, but here it means physically lowered.
explanation.definitionFit: Flowered is the past tense of flower, meaning to bloom.

clue.text: Rare creature certainly seen more than once

indicators.note: seen more than once tells us the word appears twice in a row

parts.note: aye is an emphatic yes, certainly

explanation.surface: A rare animal is definitely spotted repeatedly.
explanation.definitionFit: The aye-aye is an endangered lemur of Madagascar, a rare animal.

clue.text: Blade getting deeper as skin is pared back

indicators.note: back means the remaining letters are read in reverse order
paring away the skin removes the outer letters of the word deeper

explanation.surface: A knife cutting deeper while peeling the skin.
explanation.walkthrough: Skinning DEEPER leaves EEPE, and 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: An épée is a fencing sword, which is a kind of blade.

clue.text: Regularly envelop parcel with a lot of new polymer

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, here the second, fourth and so on
a lot of means most of the word, so its last letter goes

parts.note: taken as written before trimming

explanation.surface: Instructions to wrap a package with plenty of fresh synthetic material.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'envelop parcel' give NEOPRE; 'a lot of' trims NEW to NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Neoprene is a synthetic rubber, a polymer of chloroprene.

clue.text: Phone conversation that is about work for music-maker

parts.note: a call is a conversation by phone

indicators.note: about means the abbreviation goes round the work piece

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, that is
op, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A phone chat about a job leads to a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: A calliope is a steam organ, an instrument that makes music; also the Muse of epic poetry.

clue.text: Tropical plant that's unique, not needing nitrogen

indicators.note: not needing means a letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: something unique stands alone
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A one-of-a-kind tropical plant that requires no nitrogen fertiliser.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloes are succulent plants of warm, dry regions, such as aloe vera.

clue.text: Something astronauts feel is good for the modern age

parts.note: taken as written
CE, Common Era, labels the modern dating era

explanation.surface: A claim that something felt by astronauts benefits the present era.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronauts experience strong acceleration forces at launch, measured in multiples of gravity.

clue.text: Vision absolutely needed to be part of a rowing team

indicators.note: to be part of puts the word inside the team

parts.note: an eight is a rowing crew of eight oarsmen
absolutely is an emphatic yes

explanation.surface: Good vision is a must for anyone joining a rowing crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesight is the faculty of seeing, synonymous with vision.

clue.text: Caught cheek with earring, perhaps

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
lip means cheek, impudent talk

explanation.surface: Someone's face is snagged by a piece of jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: A clip-on earring fastens by a small clasp, so an earring is an example of a clip.

clue.text: Arranging a mobile ban could be awful

indicators.note: arranging the letters puts them into a new order

explanation.surface: Setting up a mobile phone ban could be dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Abominable means terrible or very unpleasant, a synonym of awful.

clue.text: My military company holds record for expertise with rust?

indicators.note: holds means the company word contains the record word

parts.note: COY is the military abbreviation for company
a log is a record, as in a ship's log

explanation.surface: My army unit keeps records of its rust-proofing skills.
explanation.walkthrough: Rust here is the plant disease caused by fungi, not corroded iron.
explanation.definitionFit: Mycology is the study of fungi, which include the rusts that attack plants.

clue.text: Small shrub yielding rubber

parts.note: heath is a low evergreen shrub, heather

explanation.surface: A little bush produces latex.
explanation.walkthrough: Rubber suggests latex from plants; here it is slang for a condom.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubber is slang for a condom, also called a sheath.

clue.text: Not getting us, ring to cancel

indicators.note: not getting means the named letters are removed

parts.note: an annulus is a ring shape
taken as written

explanation.surface: Without us, a phone call to call something off.
explanation.definitionFit: To annul a marriage or contract is to declare it void, cancelling it.

clue.text: Vehicle on tow, empty, needs to tilt in sideways turn

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle

indicators.note: empty removes the middle, leaving just the outer letters

parts.note: to heel is to tilt over, as a ship does

explanation.surface: An empty towed vehicle has to tip over in a sideways swerve.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartwheel is a gymnastic move turning sideways over the hands.

clue.text: East Russian fighter concerned with defector?

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter jet
re means concerning, about

explanation.surface: A Russian jet from the east linked to someone who switched sides.
explanation.definitionFit: An émigré has left their country, often for political reasons, as a defector may.

clue.text: Be rather prim with attitude over service?

parts.note: a stand is a position or attitude taken
on means over, as in on the table
a religious service is a ceremony

explanation.surface: Being a bit prissy with one's position on a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand on ceremony is to insist on formal behaviour, to be stiffly correct.

clue.text: Company manager presents Tosca, perhaps, to queen

parts.note: Tosca is a Puccini opera, an example
taken as written
R stands for Regina, queen

explanation.surface: A theatre boss stages Tosca for the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: An operator runs a business, such as a tour operator managing a firm.

clue.text: Knock top off butcher's cutting blade

indicators.note: knock top off removes the first letter of the word

parts.note: butcher's hook is Cockney rhyming slang for look, so a glance

explanation.surface: Striking the head off a butcher's knife.
explanation.walkthrough: Butcher's is British rhyming slang: butcher's hook means look.
explanation.definitionFit: A lance is a sharp pointed weapon or surgical knife used for cutting.

clue.text: Martin and Roy are prepared to join in matrimony

indicators.note: are prepared means the letters are made ready in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Two men named Martin and Roy are ready to get married.
explanation.definitionFit: To marry into a family is to become part of it through a wedding.

clue.text: Act quite in Puck's manner

parts.note: to act is to play a part
quite in the sense of fully, completely

explanation.surface: Performing exactly as Puck would.
explanation.walkthrough: Puck is the mischievous sprite of A Midsummer Night's Dream.
explanation.definitionFit: Puck acts mischievously and in jest, which is to behave playfully.

clue.text: Give further spirit to drunken marine with tea

indicators.note: drunken suggests letters reeling about into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipsy marine sobered up with a cuppa.
explanation.definitionFit: To reanimate is to bring back to life, restoring vigour or spirit.

clue.text: English doormat unravelled with steady beating

indicators.note: unravelled means the letters are untangled and rearranged

explanation.surface: An English doormat falls apart under regular beating.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderato is a musical tempo marking meaning at a moderate, steady pace.

clue.text: Information on one American mastermind

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
I is the Roman numeral one
US abbreviates United States, so American

explanation.surface: An American is fed intelligence by a criminal brain.
explanation.definitionFit: A genius is a person of exceptional intellect, a brilliant mind.

clue.text: Copy sappers like a expert

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, whose soldiers are called sappers
a pro is an expert professional

explanation.surface: Military engineers copying like a professional.
explanation.definitionFit: A repro is a reproduction, a copy of an original.

clue.text: Spartan's fate hanging on Athens' heart

indicators.note: hanging on means the fate word comes after, attached to the end
the heart of a word is its central letters

parts.note: one's lot is one's fate

explanation.surface: A Spartan's destiny depends on the core of Athens.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of ATHENS is HE; Spartan's here means Spartan is.
explanation.definitionFit: Helots were the serf class of ancient Sparta, so a helot is a Spartan.
